subject: ClearHarbor onboarding: PO issuance, spend caps, SKU corrections
messages:
From: Liam Torres <liam.torres@clearharbor.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@clearharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding: initial PO(s) + spend cap request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the walkthrough today. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the draft line-item sheet the procurement team asked for. We are ready to be issued a PO so we can kickoff the pilot (1 month, estimated $60k). A few notes: 
- We need two PO lines split by SKU: platform usage vs professional services.
- Finance in CC prefers a single spend cap of $75,000 for the first 90 days.
- Would prefer PO referencing SOW ID CH-SOW-221.

Could you confirm the PO number(s) and whether Redwood can accept the split lines? We expect an initial invoice the week after go-live.

Attachments: clearharbor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 310KB), clearharbor_lineitem_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

Best,
Liam Torres
Head of Partnerships
ClearHarbor Inc

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding: initial PO(s) + spend cap request

Forwarding ClearHarbor's onboarding pack. Two asks: assign PO numbers (split lines) and confirm spend cap of $75k for 90 days. Finance wants explicit line-item mapping so invoices route correctly. Connor - can you provision PO(s) and let me know the numbering convention? Ben - heads up, sales will need the POs on the invoice to complete the revenue recognition checklist.

For clarity: 
- Platform SKU: CH-PLAT-001 (estimate $45k)
- Professional Services SKU: CH-PS-003 (estimate $15k)
- SOW ID: CH-SOW-221

Please reply with PO numbers and attach the generated PO PDFs. If we need a temporary provisional PO before full finance sign-off, flag it.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@clearharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding: initial PO(s) + spend cap request

Stephanie / Ben —

I provisioned two PO numbers in our ledger as requested. See summary below and attached PDFs/CSV for accounting. Finance will still need to formally approve the $75k cap; I've flagged the ticket for expedited review (JIRA SUP-2245).

PO summary:
- PO 73451 — ClearHarbor Inc — Platform SKU CH-PLAT-001 — amount authorized $45,000 — linked SOW CH-SOW-221
- PO 73452 — ClearHarbor Inc — Professional Services SKU CH-PS-003 — amount authorized $15,000 — linked SOW CH-SOW-221

Combined provisional spend cap: $60,000 pending finance approval to increase to $75,000 for 90 days. If finance approves the $75k change I will update both POs to include an authorized overage buffer field.

Attachments: po_73451.pdf (PDF, 28KB), po_73452.csv (CSV, 2KB)

Connor
Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Torres <liam.torres@clearharbor.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial PO(s) + spend cap request

Thanks Connor — that's perfect for sales ops. Two quick items: 
1) Can procurement add a single combined PO reference on invoices (e.g. PO 73451/73452) so ClearHarbor's AP team can map payments to one receipt?
2) I'll ask legal to confirm the SOW reference language; we sometimes need "Reference: SOW CH-SOW-221" on the PO footer.

Liam — we will target sending the POs and a DocuSign packet by Monday once finance gives the spend-cap thumbs up. If your team needs the invoices to hit a single PO field, Connor indicated we can add a combined reference.

—Ben
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Torres <liam.torres@clearharbor.com>, Finance Ops <finance@clearharbor.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial PO(s) + spend cap request

Liam / Finance team —

Final confirmation: Procurement provisioned PO 73451 and 73452 as provisional authorizations for ClearHarbor. Finance approved the $75,000 spend cap for the first 90 days (approval logged in SUP-2245). Connor attached the signed POs and we've published the DocuSign packet here: https://docusign.example/sign/CH-ONB-73451. 

Notes and next steps: 
- Invoices may reference PO 73451/73452; Redwood AP will accept either but recommends putting "PO 73451" in the primary PO field and listing 73452 in the invoice notes for faster reconciliation.
- Connor also corrected the line-item SKU mapping: platform usage must include the hourly usage band (CH-PLAT-001-A) for accurate billing. Updated line-item sheet attached.
- Liam, please countersign the DocuSign packet and route the initial invoice to invoices@redwood.ai.

Attachments: po_73451.pdf, clearharbor_lineitem_breakdown.xlsx

Thanks everyone — welcome aboard.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
